sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def resolve_env_vars(value):
    """解析环境变量占位符 ${VAR_NAME}"""
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith('${') and value.endswith('}'):
        var_name = value[2:-1]
        return os.getenv(var_name, value)
